description: Token-cost calibration for the Hermes overhead estimate. Values are tokens per invocation. Re-calibrate by measuring a real session via /compact or transcript inspection. v2 will replace this estimate with direct measurement from a SessionEnd hook.
_notes: claude_md_per_turn: cc-forge minimum document set is ~600 tokens; recompute when CLAUDE.md changes substantially.
commands./hermes-gate-review: a single-persona gate. Multi-persona reviews multiply by personas invoked.
commands./hermes-phase-gate: full-panel cost is mostly captured via persona_invocation entries; the 8000 here is for the orchestration agent itself.
persona_invocation: average subagent context + output, used when the log entry doesn't break out per-command cost.
